purpose: Evidence for an improvement plan; no application code was modified.

tests.environment: macOS, .venv-edit, outside sandbox to initialize native Qt
tests.first_attempt: Sandbox run aborted while importing Qt after 54 progress dots; not counted as a successful run.

probe_method.filesystem_scope: TemporaryDirectory under /private/tmp; synthetic files only; temporary fixture directories were removed on completion.
probe_method.history_branching: Construct a real one-cell ChangeSet. On a real History instance repeat cursor=0; append(change) 100 times. Inspect entries, SQLite SELECT count(*) and _cache.
probe_method.unsaved_after_save: EditSession.from_structure with DataVersion 3955, size [2,1,1], stone at [0,0,0]. Set it to gold, apply, save NBT, compare dirty with changes_view.summary(unsaved_changes(session)); undo and compare with a separately reopened saved file.
probe_method.partial_world_install: Real StagedWorld with two synthetic .dat text files. Stage new contents through file(), mark changed, inject OSError on os.replace for b.dat. Inspect both files and backup manifest.
probe_method.restore_created_file: Real StagedWorld with a previously absent new.dat. Install, verify backup and restore. Inspect before hash, exception cause and existence of the newly created target.
probe_method.clipboard_version_check: Copy a real DataVersion 3955 EditSession selection and paste into DataVersion 2865 at [0,0,0], include_air=True. This only proves acceptance without a version gate, not corruption.

result.scope: synthetic test only; no Structura or Minecraft files accessed

limitations: No complete pytest suite or full native GUI workflow was run.
No real Minecraft world was written or corruption demonstrated.
No physical trackpad or accessibility evaluation was performed.
No broad performance benchmark or user study was performed.
Other findings in the plan are explicitly static observations or proposals.
